content.name: Unique Ship Limits
content.description:
A handful of ships in X4 are capped at one. The Astrid is the blunt case - the game tells you so in as many words: "There is no way to manufacture another Astrid-class ship once the ones already in existence are destroyed." Lose it and the wharf entry stays greyed out with a padlock, blueprint or no blueprint.
That cap turns out to be a single number per ship, stored in your profile. This mod puts a switch on it.
[h2]Settings[/h2] Five switches, all off by default, and off is the vanilla value - so installing the mod changes nothing until you turn one on. [list] [*][b]Astrid unlimited[/b] - the Northriver yacht from Tides of Avarice. [*][b]Experimental Shuttle unlimited[/b] - from the Timelines epilogue. [*][b]Boron story corvette unlimited[/b] - the Kingdom End story reward. [*][b]Timelines racers unlimited[/b] - all four at once: the Argon, Generic, Paranid and Teladi racers. [*][b]Erlking stays buildable[/b] - a different mechanism entirely, see below. [*][b]Debug logging[/b] - off by default. Writes what the mod does to the debug log; needs the game started with -debug scripts. [/list] [b]None of this hands you a blueprint.[/b] Every one of these ships still needs the blueprint its story gives you. If you have not done the story, the switch does nothing for that ship.
The cap counts ships you currently own, not ships you have ever built, so under vanilla rules losing one already frees the slot. The switch is for wanting two at the same time, or for a ship that is gone for good.
[h2]The Erlking[/h2] The Erlking has no counter. Its ware lists research_erlking_core as a production precursor, and the vanilla story script takes that research away the moment you queue a build - so the first one is free and the second is impossible until you go and recover the power core again.
With the switch on, the mod puts the research back, using the same two actions vanilla itself runs when you cancel an Erlking build, a few seconds after the build is queued and again on every savegame load. You keep as many as you can pay for. It only ever does that once you already hold the Erlking blueprint, so nothing about the story up to that point changes.
[h2]Where to change them[/h2] With SirNukes Mod Support APIs installed: [b]Options - Extension Options - Unique Ship Limits[/b].
Without that API the mod runs off the constants at the top of md/drjele_unique_ship_limits.xml, re-read on every savegame load - editing one and reloading is enough, no new game is needed. Any other mod or cheat menu can also override them at runtime through the globals $DrJeleUniqueShipAstridUnlimited, $DrJeleUniqueShipExperimentalShuttleUnlimited, $DrJeleUniqueShipBoronCorvetteUnlimited, $DrJeleUniqueShipTimelinesRacerUnlimited and $DrJeleUniqueShipErlkingRebuildable.
There is no "no limit" value for the counter, so a lifted cap is simply set to 1000. If you would rather cap a ship at some exact number instead of removing the cap, change $UnlimitedLimit in the configuration cue and the switches set that number instead.
[h2]Read this before turning a switch on[/h2] The value is [b]not[/b] stored in your savegame. It lives in userdata.xml, next to your saves - the same profile-level store that holds your custom gamestart unlocks. Two consequences worth knowing: [list] [*]a raised limit applies to [b]every save on this profile[/b], not just the one you were playing; [*]it [b]survives uninstalling the mod[/b], because an uninstalled mod gets no chance to put it back. [/list] To go back to stock: turn every switch off, load a save so the apply step runs, save, and only then remove the extension. Failing that, the seven limited_blueprint entries can be edited in userdata.xml by hand with the game closed.
[h2]Dependencies[/h2] [list] [*][b]X4: Foundations 9.00[/b] - required. [*][b]SirNukes Mod Support APIs[/b] - optional, and only for the in-game options menu. Everything works without it. [*]No DLC required. A switch for a ship whose DLC you do not own costs nothing and simply means nothing. [/list]
[h2]Notes[/h2] Works on an existing savegame. No vanilla file is patched: the whole mod is two Mission Director scripts and five userdata writes, so it is save-compatible in both directions and cannot collide with another mod's XPath. The value is re-applied on every load, so a future game update quietly putting the cap back does not survive the next reload.
Source and full documentation: https://github.com/drjele/x4-unique-ship-limits

text.name: Unique Ship Limits
text.description: Switches that lift the build limit on the unique ships: Astrid, Experimental Shuttle, the Boron story corvette and the Timelines racers, plus one that keeps the Erlking research so a second one can be built. Blueprints are still required. Works on an existing savegame.

dependency.comment: only for the in-game options menu; the mod works without it
